messages:
maria: Heads up — embeddings svc in eu-west1 is spiking 503s since ~01:22 UTC. Root looks like KV cache overflow after the quant path tweak. Requesting expedited hotfix deploy: image rwinf/embeddings:v2.1.3-embed-fix. Can we get quick approvals to reduce user impact?

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: New deploy request queued (id: deploy-7863). Target: embeddings-eu-west1. Canary plan defaults: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m windows. Policy: 2/3 approvals allow canary-skip; ops-oncall consent required for full skip. Approve with `/deploy approve deploy-7863` or reply in-thread.

vikram: What's the exact rollback criteria? Need thresholds to vote.

maria: Rollback criteria I propose: errors >1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency >800ms sustained 5m OR token cost uplift >10% vs baseline. Also any customer-facing SLA alerts.

sam: +1 from infra side. prefer staged canary but ok with expedited.

dana: I'm oncall — I can approve but prefer not skipping canary entirely. Can we start at 2% canary for safety?

ben: Quick note for release notes: "Fix KV cache sizing causing 503s on long-context embedding requests". Also call out temporary model pin if used.

charlie: For Dedicated customers, we need to pin model_variant during rollout. Can we add `model_variant: m-gpt-qa-q4_0` to the new image config?

maria: Adding the pin now in the rollout config: `model_variant: m-gpt-qa-q4_0`. Preparing release note and changelog entry: https://notebooks.internal/release/17499 (docs link).

deploy-bot: Approvals tally: sam, dana, ben -> 3 approvals. Ops-oncall consent present (dana). Canary plan adjusted per ops request: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Initiating deploy sequence when lead triggers.

maria: Initiating now. Command: `kubectl set image deployment/embeddings-eu embeddings=rwinf/embeddings:v2.1.3-embed-fix` and `kubectl rollout status deployment/embeddings-eu -w`. Pasting quick logs snippet below for visibility:

```
Rolling out deployment "embeddings-eu"
replicaSet "embeddings-eu-abc123" successfully rolled out
Health checks passing on new pods
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 2% (hosts: eu1-a1). Observability: no uplift in 503s in first 90s. Metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/embeddings (internal).

vikram: Looking at traces — no new error traces, latency stable. :thumbsup:

sam: Hold at 2m, then promote to 10% if green.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 10%... Promoted successfully. No regressions observed in the 3m check window. Auto-scheduling promotion to 50% in 10m.

dana: I +1 to go to 50% after that observation.

ben: For the public changelog add: "Temporarily pinned model_variant for stability; fix KV cache sizing". I'll add the line.

maria: 10m observation window started. If anything breaches rollback criteria we will abort and rollback. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback deploy-7863`.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 50% now... Promotion complete. Metrics: errors down to baseline, p95 latency improved ~12%. Scheduling final promotion to 100% in 15m.

charlie: I'll tag the commit and update the repo changelog now.

maria: Thanks — if we see any uplift within the next 15m I will execute rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: 100% rollout complete at 02:01 UTC. No regressions detected during windows. Closing deploy-7863. If issues appear, escalate in #incidents. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and the release note entry once it's merged.
